entries.title: I Chronicles 1:1
segments: ¶Adam, Seth, Enosh;

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:2
segments: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:3
segments: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech;

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:4
segments: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:5
segments: The sons of Japheth: Gomer and Magog and Madai and Javan and Tubal and Meshech and Tiras.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:6
segments: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz and Diphath and Togarmah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:7
segments: And the sons of Javan: Elishah and Tarshish, Kittim and Rodanim.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:8
segments: The sons of Ham: Cush and Egypt, Put and Canaan.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:9
segments: And the sons of Cush: Seba and Havilah and Sabta and Raama and Sabteca. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:10
segments: And Cush was the father of Nimrod: he was the first to be a great man in the earth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:11
segments: And Egypt was the father of the Ludim and the Anamim and the Lehabim and the Naphtuhim

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:12
segments: And the Pathrusim and the Casluhim and the Caphtorim (from whom came the Philistines).

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:13
segments: And Canaan was the father of Zidon, his oldest son, and Heth,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:14
segments: And the Jebusite and the Amorite and the Girgashite,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:15
segments: And the Hivite and the Arkite and the Sinite,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:16
segments: And the Arvadite and the Zemarite and the Hamathite.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:17
segments: The sons of Shem: Elam and Asshur and Arpachshad and Lud and Aram and Uz and Hul and Gether and Meshech.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:18
segments: And Arpachshad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:19
segments: And Eber had two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, because in his days a division was made of the earth; and his brother's name was Joktan.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:20
segments: And Joktan was the father of Almodad and Sheleph and Hazarmaveth and Jerah

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:21
segments: And Hadoram and Uzal and Diklah

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:22
segments: And Ebal and Abimael and Sheba

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:23
segments: And Ophir and Havilah and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:24
segments: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:25
segments: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:26
segments: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:27
segments: Abram (that is Abraham).

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:28
segments: ¶The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:29
segments: These are their generations: the oldest son of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar and Adbeel and Mibsam,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:30
segments: Mishma and Dumah, Massa, Hadad and Tema,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:31
segments: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:32
segments: And the sons of Keturah, Abraham's servant-wife: she was the mother of Zimran and Jokshan and Medan and Midian and Ishbak and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:33
segments: And the sons of Midian: Ephah and Epher and Hanoch and Abida and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:34
segments: And Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:35
segments: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel and Jeush and Jalam and Korah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:36
segments: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman and Omar, Zephi and Gatam, Kenaz and Timna and Amalek.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:37
segments: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:38
segments: And the sons of Seir: Lotan and Shobal and Zibeon and Anah and Dishon and Ezer and Dishan.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:39
segments: And the sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan's sister.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:40
segments: The sons of Shobal: Alian and Manahath and Ebal, Shephi and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:41
segments: The sons of Anah: Dishon. And the sons of Dishon: Hamran and Eshban and Ithran and Cheran.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:42
segments: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan and Zaavan, Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:43
segments: Now these are the kings who were ruling in the land of Edom, before there was any king over Israel: Bela, the son of Beor; his town was named Dinhabah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:44
segments: At his death, Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, became king in his place.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:45
segments: At the death of Jobab, Husham, from the land of the Temanites, became king in his place.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:46
segments: And at the death of Husham, Hadad, the son of Bedad, who overcame Midian in the field of Moab, became king; his town was named Avith.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:47
segments: And at the death of Hadad, Samlah of Masrekah became king in his place.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:48
segments: And at the death of Samlah, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river became king in his place,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:49
segments: And at the death of Shaul, Baal-hanan, the son of Achbor, became king in his place.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:50
segments: And at the death of Baal-hanan, Hadad became king in his place; his town was named Pai, and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:51
segments: And Hadad came to his end. Now the chiefs of Edom were: the chief of Timna, the chief of Aliah, the chief of Jetheth,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:52
segments: The chief of Oholibamah, the chief of Elah, the chief of Pinon,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:53
segments: The chief of Kenaz, the chief of Teman, the chief of Mibzar,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:54
segments: The chief of Magdiel, the chief of Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.
